rationale: This is a near-mechanical restatement of the already-tested "Self-Funded Intangible Reinvestment" (identical reinvestment-share leg up to the ABS denominator, and a first leg that differs only by adding back the intangible spend already captured in leg two), which failed with fmb 1.38 and negative alpha, so it offers no new economic content.

The intangible-share-of-SG&A leg is essentially the archived "Productive Intangible Overhead" second leg with 3-year smoothing, and swapping the level of oibdp/xsga for its 3-year trend recreates the margin-trend × intangible-intensity structure already tested in "Intangible Harvest Operating Leverage," making this a hybrid variant of two weak-to-moderate predecessors rather than a new mechanism.

The two legs are mechanically coupled — adding xrd+xad back into the margin numerator means a firm whose intangible intensity is rising automatically ranks high in its own time-series of "intangible-adjusted margin" — so the interaction can fire on spending escalation rather than productivity, and the design otherwise overlaps "Sustained Intangible Margin Breakout" (fmb 1.63, alpha 0.003) and the TS_RANK construction of "Goodwill-Light Intangible Cash High."

This is the mirror image of the already-evaluated "Acquired Intangible Cash Decay" (goodwill weight × cash-margin trend, sign flipped) and therefore mostly re-tests the same axis, and the denominator ADD(at, gdwl) double-counts goodwill since it is already inside total assets.

The expensed-versus-recognized intangible "gap" leg is a genuinely new comparison in this archive and a coherent test of accounting understatement, though the reviewer should note two risks: for firms with missing intan the leg degenerates to plain R&D/advertising intensity (already paired with margins in several archived signals), and high values can be driven mechanically by amortization-driven declines in intangible assets rather than by internal capital formation.

Two of the three legs (lagged intangible intensity, negative trend in intangible spend intensity) are identical to "Intangible Harvest Operating Leverage," so the only change is substituting a cash-conversion trend for the margin trend — a cosmetic variant — and the ABS(oibdp) denominator makes the conversion ratio non-monotonic for loss-making firms.
